newsitem.title: POLAND: Binding buys 49 pct of Polish brewer.
newsitem.headline: Binding buys 49 pct of Polish brewer.

text.p: German brewer Binding Brauerei AG and Polish investment firm Ambresa sp zoo have bought 49-percent and 48-percent stakes respectively in Polish brewer Dojlidy sp zoo, Dojlidy said in a statement on Tuesday.

"The management...of Dojlidy at the end of 1996 approved the sale of a majority stake -- with 49 percent taken up by Binding...and 48 percent transferred from the hitherto owners to Ambres," the statement said.
The firm was owned by employees. The statement said Binding would invest a minimum of 50 million zlotys in Dojlidy, which sold 300,000 hectolitres of beer last year.
It said the new owners would maintain the Dojlidy brand, which made up the majority of its sales.
The daily Gazeta Wyborcza reported on Tuesday that the two firms paid a total of 24 million zlotys for the stakes and that Ambres was a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bank Rozwoju Eksportu SA (BRE).
No officials at Dojlidy and BRE were immediately available for comment.
